name: @kanzo-tech/navigation
description: Kanzo's unsaved-changes guard — one useBlocker in TanStack Router's shape over the Navigation API and beforeunload, and a /next door for the App Router's Link and router. Sibling of @kanzo-tech/ui, not part of it: a router integration is product territory by /docs/philosophy, and nothing here draws.
//peers: react is REQUIRED: the root is a hook. next is optional and lives behind `./next`, from 15.3 because that is the release `Link` gained `onNavigate` — the only cancellable moment Next gives a link. A host that is not Next installs this package alone and gets the browser half. Deliberately absent: tailwind-variants and @kanzo-tech/ui, because nothing here draws; the confirm dialog is the product's AlertDialog. That absence is also what keeps this package out of the appearance guards, whose corpus in packages/ui/src/guard-corpus.ts selects on that dependency.
//size-limit: Set just above the first measurement, for the reason auth's note gives: a budget with 70% headroom detects nothing. The root barrel measured 1.06 kB — the hook, the registry and the two listeners — and `./next` 1.04 kB — the two adapters and the registry they share with the root; both budgets are 1.2 kB. `next` is ignored on the second because the consumer installs it and what is measured is our adapter over it. What these numbers watch for is a door reaching through another: the root learning a router, or `./next` pulling the hook and the listeners in behind `Link`. Either is a jump of the size of the other door, and a raise is a decision written here, never a quiet edit.
